title: Binary Search
prompt: Binary search (reported as the first question, alongside optimising an API). The reviewer said interviewers cared about fundamentals and how you approach the problem rather than Q&A.
follow_ups: Lower/upper bound variants (first and last occurrence).
Binary search on the answer (e.g. minimum capacity).

title: How would you optimise a slow API?
prompt: Optimising an API (reported with binary search in the same round). Expect: measure first (p95/p99, traces), find the bottleneck (DB, downstream calls, serialisation, pool exhaustion), then fix and verify.
follow_ups: Which metrics and traces would you look at first?
How do you stop a slow dependency from taking the API down (timeouts, circuit breaker, bulkhead)?
Caching: what, where, and how do you invalidate?

title: Walk Me Through Your Current Work / Projects
prompt: Walk through your current work and projects; follow-ups probe depth on whatever you mention.

sighting.round: Technical round ("How does your day look like")

title: Polymorphism, and can static methods be overridden?
prompt: Explain polymorphism. Can static methods be overridden? (Static methods are hidden, not overridden: the call is bound at compile time to the reference type.)
follow_ups: Can you override a private or final method?
What does @Override do if you put it on a static method?

title: SOLID principles and dependency inversion
prompt: SOLID principles (round 1 also covered core Java, Spring Boot, SQL queries, one coding problem and system design).

title: OAuth and JWT tokens
prompt: API security, including JWT/OAuth libraries (contract full-stack role; mostly resume/project questions plus easy-medium whiteboard coding).

title: The four OOP principles
prompt: Explain the four principles of OOP (encapsulation, abstraction, inheritance, polymorphism) with Java examples. Reported with simple code-fixing and logic tests in a backend-focused technical round.
follow_ups: Abstract class vs interface in Java 8+.
Composition over inheritance: when and why?

title: Shortest Path Between Two Vertices in a Weighted Graph
prompt: Weighted undirected graph and two vertices; find the shortest path between them.

sighting.round: Technical round (write a shortest-path graph algorithm)
